'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war|Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Siege of Gaza City]]
***At least 17 [[Palestinians]] are killed and 80 others are injured in an [[Israel]]i airstrike on a [[UNWRA]]-run school used to shelter displaced people in the [[Nuseirat refugee camp]] in [[Gaza City]]. The [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] claims that a [[Hamas]] command center was there. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/least-17-palestinians-killed-israeli-strikes-gaza-overnight-officials-say-2024-07-14/ (Reuters)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/jul/14/palestinians-killed-latest-attack-on-gaza-city-say-officials (''The Guardian'')][https://www.jpost.com/israel-hamas-war/article-810305 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
**The IDF claims on [[X (social network)|X]] that it has killed [[Rafa Salama]], the commander of the [[Khan Yunis]] Brigade of the [[Al-Qassam Brigades]], in [[13 July 2024 al-Mawasi attack|the previous day's strikes]]. Hamas, meanwhile, claims that [[List of leaders of Hamas#List of military leaders in the Gaza Strip|commander]] [[Mohammed Deif]] remains alive. [https://thedefensepost.com/2024/07/15/top-hamas-commander-killed/ (''The Defense Post'')] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-confirms-khan-younis-brigade-chief-killed-in-gaza-strike-deifs-fate-unknown/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.politico.com/news/2024/07/14/hamas-military-chief-israeli-strike-00168106 (Politico)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Russia]] takes control of [[Urozhaine, Donetsk Oblast|Urozhaine]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], which [[Ukraine]] had previously recaptured in July 2023. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/russia-claims-control-urozhaine-village-ukraines-donetsk-region-2024-07-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali civil war (2009–present)|Somali civil war]]
**[[Top Coffee bombing]]
***Nine people are killed and 20 others are injured when a [[car bomb]] explodes outside a [[Top Cafe bombing|cafe]] in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]], while customers were watching the [[UEFA Euro 2024 final|Euro 2024 final]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/15/deadly-car-bomb-targets-busy-cafe-in-the-somali-capital (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents''' 
*Three [[Italy|Italian]] [[Hiking|hikers]] are killed during accidents on the [[Mont Blanc]]. [https://www.bolognatoday.it/cronaca/alpinisti-morti-monte-bianco-michele-raule-san-lazzaro.html (Bologna Today)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Russia relations]]
**The [[Russian Navy]] and [[China]]'s [[People's Liberation Army Navy]] begin joint military drills in [[Zhanjiang]], [[Guangdong]], [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-russia-joint-naval-drills-nato-ukraine-08590a566d76ae1ddc47dde7cea8ad1a (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Attempted assassination of Donald Trump in Pennsylvania|Attempted assassination of Donald Trump]]
**The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] identifies [[Thomas Matthew Crooks]] as the "subject involved" in yesterday's attempted assassination of former [[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] in [[Butler, Pennsylvania|Butler]], [[Pennsylvania]], [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-shooting-raises-questions-about-security-lapses-2024-07-14/ (Reuters)]
*Two people are killed and two others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a home in [[Lautlingen]], [[Baden-Württemberg]], [[Germany]]. The shooter later commits [[suicide]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/several-dead-attack-germanys-baden-wuerttemberg-state-bild-2024-07-14/ (Reuters)]
*Twenty-seven people, including [[Colombian Football Federation]] president [[Ramón Jesurún]], are arrested and 55 are [[Ejection (sports)|ejected]] following [[crowd control]] issues at [[Hard Rock Stadium]] in [[Miami Gardens, Florida|Miami Gardens]], [[Florida]], U.S., before the [[2024 Copa América final|Copa América final]], where fans breached security gates at the stadium's entrance. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/miamidade-police-department-ap-police-copa-america-colombia-b2580264.html (''The Independent'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**Palestinians in several cities in the occupied [[West Bank]] enact a [[general strike]] in protest against a recent [[13 July 2024 al-Mawasi attack|Israeli strike]] on [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] that killed 90 people and injured 300 more. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/14/palestinians-strike-in-occupied-west-bank-against-israeli-killings-in-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
*[[KP Sharma Oli]] is named as the new [[Prime Minister of Nepal]] in his fourth term in office, with his [[Communist Party of Nepal (Unified Marxist–Leninist)|communist party]] forming a coalition with the [[Nepali Congress]] party. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/14/leader-of-nepals-largest-communist-party-named-new-prime-minister (Al Jazeera)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 Wimbledon Championships]]
**In [[tennis]], defending champion [[Carlos Alcaraz]] defeats [[Novak Djokovic]] 6–2, 6–2, 7–6<sup>(7–4)</sup> in the [[2024 Wimbledon Championships – Men's singles |Men's singles final]] to win his second [[Wimbledon Championships|Wimbledon]] title and his fourth overall [[Grand Slam (tennis)#Tournaments|Grand Slam]] title. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/article/2024/jul/14/carlos-alcaraz-novak-djokovic-wimbledon-mens-singles-final-match-report/ (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.wimbledon.com/en_GB/news/articles/2024-07-14/alcaraz_stuns_djokovic_to_take_second_wimbledon_title.html/ (Wimbledon)]
*[[UEFA Euro 2024]]
**In [[association football]], [[Spain national football team|Spain]] defeat [[England national football team|England]] 2–1 in the [[UEFA Euro 2024 final|final match]] to win their fourth [[UEFA European Championship]] title, having previously won in [[1964 European Nations' Cup|1964]], [[UEFA Euro 2008|2008]], and [[UEFA Euro 2012|2012]], the [[UEFA European Championship records and statistics#All-time|most]] by any team. [https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/liveblog/2024/7/14/live-spain-vs-england-uefa-euro-2024-final (Al Jazeera)]
